# Data Integrity Checklist: Generic Product-Line Seeder

**Purpose**: Validate data-integrity requirement quality for the Generic Product-Line Seeder before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-05-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Deterministic Config Projection

- [x] CHK001 Are the required YAML sections and schema marker sufficient to deterministically identify the product line, GitHub ownership, workflow contract, departments, assignments, feature flags, governance defaults, and safety policy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are config identity, version, duplicate, unknown-field, and semantic validation requirements defined before write-capable runs can mutate target state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are GitHub repository ownership rules defined clearly enough to block target-conflicting residue without relying on implementation-specific inference? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK004 Are workflow-contract family, path, and required-slug validation requirements measurable and bounded to the supported Mission Control family? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK005 Are feature-flag registry, disabled/absent, reserved-future, duplicate, conflict, cascade, and force-off requirements complete for deterministic workspace flag projection? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK006 Are agent assignment requirements explicit about `agent_prefix`, `agent_key`, derived names, department mapping, and shared-support scope? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK007 Are governance defaults mapped to existing policy concepts with measurable first-intake-blocking rejection requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]

## Existing Target Preservation

- [x] CHK008 Are existing-target refusal and `--allow-existing` requirements unambiguous for apply mode and read-only verify mode? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, §FR-021]
- [x] CHK009 Are config-owned update surfaces enumerated precisely enough to distinguish reviewed seed changes from preserved target state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK010 Are non-config-owned operational/history preservation requirements complete for issues, tasks, task evidence/read-model state, activities, histories, comments, notifications, dispositions, artifacts, quality reviews, GitHub sync state, governance audit rows, manual templates, row identity, timestamps, counters, lineage, and unrelated flags? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK011 Are success criteria measurable for preserving non-owned issue, task, activity, history, and related operational state during existing-target apply? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK012 Are requirements explicit that target residue blocking is detection-only and never performs automatic deletion or unlinking? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027]

## No-Mutation Evidence

- [x] CHK013 Do invalid-config and blocked-preflight no-mutation snapshot requirements cover every preserved non-config-owned operational/history surface named by existing-target preservation requirements, rather than only a narrower task/history subset? [Resolved] [Spec §FR-017, §FR-020, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK014 Are snapshot hash requirements specific about stable ordered-JSON SHA-256 formatting and before/after comparison? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK015 Are redaction requirements defined for residue and failure evidence so counts/hashes can be reviewed without exposing credentials, tokens, raw logs, signed URLs, raw untrusted payloads, or matched secret substrings? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK016 Are invalid config, unsupported workflow, invalid flag, unsafe governance, existing-target refusal, and ownership conflict scenarios required to fail before writes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, §SC-006, §SC-008]
- [x] CHK017 Are no-mutation requirements explicit that invalid-config or blocked-preflight proof must not call a dry-run/import path that persists diagnostics before snapshots are compared? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]

## Mission Control Parity And Idempotency

- [x] CHK018 Are Mission Control parity requirements defined for applying the canonical config once, applying it again with `--allow-existing`, and verifying stable target state? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK019 Are compatibility-wrapper requirements consistent with the generic command evidence, refusal, and idempotent apply behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-023, §SC-011]
- [x] CHK020 Are duplicate-prevention requirements measurable for product-line, department, assignment, workflow, governance, and config-owned feature-flag records? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK021 Are review-packet requirements complete for reviewed config path, apply-twice evidence, verify evidence, invalid-config no-mutation evidence, existing-target behavior, and scope-exclusion evidence? [Completeness, Spec §Reviewability Requirements]

## Scope Boundary Integrity

- [x] CHK022 Are requirements clear that seeding never mutates GitHub, creates Product Line B, dispatches work, claims tasks, launches runners, creates sandboxes, creates harness adapters, auto-merges, or invokes SpecKit setup/autopilot? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, §FR-026]
- [x] CHK023 Are future-product-line reuse requirements bounded to schema/config reuse without adding Product Line B onboarding output or live smoke evidence in SPEC-010A? [Scope, Spec §FR-028, §SC-013]
